fraud.text: Based on our examination of the books and records of the Company and according to the information and explanations given to us, we report that no fraud by the Company or no fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year in the course of our audit

statutory_dues.text:

timeline.summary: Aditya Rao, as authorized signatory, disclosed Pennar Industries Limited’s promoter group shareholding at 39.67% as of 31.03.2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 30(2) & 31(4).

On 8 May 2026 Pennar Industries held an EGM that transacted a preferential convertible warrant issue to promoter Pennar Holdings Private Limited and the re-appointment of RVS Ramakrishna as Independent Director, with voting results to be announced within 48 hours.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹924.8 Cr (+2.1% YoY), net profit ₹41.04 Cr (+14.9% YoY).
Pennar Industries reported FY26 consolidated total income of ₹3,666.32 crore and PAT of ₹138.83 crore, alongside ₹902.26 crore in recent order wins.
Pennar Industries announced an investment of ₹5.80 Cr for a 45% stake in joint venture ZAP91 Solar India.
Pennar Industries Limited uploaded Q4FY26 earnings conference call audio recording on its website on May 27, 2026.
Pennar Industries reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹933.7 Cr and PAT of ₹41.04 Cr, with full year FY26 revenue at ₹3,666 Cr.
Pennar Industries Q1FY27 results: Revenue ₹884.55 Cr (+3.6% YoY), PBT ₹46.8 Cr (+16% YoY), EBITDA ₹106.8 Cr (+13.3% YoY); record order book at ₹1,008 Cr for PEB India and USD 100M for PEB US
